name: c_novice
description: HYPOTHETICAL novice run, one robot, two simple scripted tasks: (1) flip both cups upright where they start (they sit on the tape crossings, so they earn the 20 flat/upright bonus each but no Base); (2) shove two ducks off the center lane into zone 2 and zone 4, one each (2x). Botguy untouched (+1 Base, written-rule reading). Not a measurement; chosen as 'robot leaves the box and does two reliable things'.
